actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's main model is the MJCF scene scene.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="dlo_workcell_template">'
The scene compiler reads angles in radians and resolves mesh files under meshes/
The scene's <option> element sets impratio, the implicitfast integrator and the elliptic cone, and sets no timestep
The actuator section lists 19 actuators: paL_actuator1 through paL_actuator8, paR_actuator1 through paR_actuator8, panda_L_rail_pos, panda_R_rail_pos and slider_pos
The Panda actuator default class sets ctrlrange -2.8973 to 2.8973 and forcerange -87 to 87
The joint2, joint4, joint6 and gripper actuators of each arm override the default control range with -1.7628 to 1.7628, -3.0718 to -0.0698, -0.0175 to 3.7525 and 0 to 255
Each arm has seven arm-joint position servos plus one gripper actuator, and each wrist carries a 6-axis force/torque sensor
The two rail actuators accept ctrlrange -0.6 to 0.6 and the obstacle slider accepts -0.4 to 0.4
The cable is a capsule chain named cableB_first to cableB_last: 120 segments, 3.5 m total, about 29 mm per segment
The cable's first body is held to the tension anchor by an equality connect constraint named cable_to_tension_anchor
The scene declares the mujoco.elasticity.wire plugin with an instance named compositecable
The Chen wire DER cable plugin requires a patched MuJoCo 3.3.2 build, and stock MuJoCo wheels do not include these plugins
The wire plugin build recipe is documented for a patched MuJoCo 3.3.2 and is not part of a stock wheel
The Franka Panda model and the clip and peg STL meshes are fetched, not shipped with the repository
Two Franka Emika Panda arms ride linear rails, one on each long edge of the board, and each rail translates along the board's long axis by +-0.60 m
Force and torque sensors are registered at the left and right wrist sites ft_L_site and ft_R_site
The model stores the home and pre_route keyframes with one qpos vector each

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed and a reset restores the model defaults, so a run repeats exactly on the same engine but no seed selects a different one

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses scene.xml for the actuator count, the per-actuator ctrlrange and the joint dimensions, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated scalar joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
the stand-in loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact, equality, tendon or plugin constraint; the 118 ball joints of the wire cable stay at zero and the finger equality is not applied

the scene needs the Chen wire DER plugin and a patched MuJoCo 3.3.2 build (README.md:93), and the Panda model and clip and peg STLs are fetched, not shipped (README.md:121-122); the real engine path was not run here
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no physical routing cell is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
